rules.rule: All agents must periodically synchronize via explicit checkpoints during collaborative workflows, using memory search and peer discovery to verify mutual alignment and system state before proceeding after major changes.
rules.description: Prevents missed discoveries, redundant work, and misalignment in multi-agent projects by ensuring agents pause at checkpoints to validate shared goals, integrate cross-agent findings, and respond to urgent state changes.
examples: Agents synchronize after rule or codebase migrations to ensure no critical updates are missed.
An agent halts and triggers checkpointing if a peer logs a stop-the-world discovery.
